comments.author: TheCoolSquare
comments.body_html: Did you see that price in the log or actually in-game? The log only prints the handbook price, which therapist will about 59% of. If it was in game make sure you don’t have any other mods that could be modifying bitcoin value somehow. Other possibility might be that the mod received bogus data from tarkov.dev

Its in-game price. I’m not sure what other mod could affect that but we just added this line to the code to fix it. Only thing I have that affects traders (that I know of) is Realism, so I’ll just assume that’s it.

inRub = price / (therapist_coef * 2);

EDIT : after looking at the realism settings, yeah its likely that. If anyone runs into this issue, try disabling this or doing the edit like we did.
